mapper.select: SELECT data_source_type AS "id", CASE data_source_type WHEN 'EMS' THEN 'EMS' WHEN 'HR_SYSTEM' THEN '인사 시스템' WHEN 'ERP' THEN '안전/교육 시스템' ELSE data_source_type END AS "name", '기존 실적 데이터 실시간 집계' AS "description", '스케줄 정보 없음' AS "schedule", TO_CHAR(MAX(created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "lastRun", COUNT(id) AS "newCount", 0 AS "duplicateCount", 0 AS "errorCount", 'NORMAL' AS "status" FROM esg_metric_data WHERE data_source_type != 'MANUAL' GROUP BY data_source_type ORDER BY MAX(created_at) DESC

SELECT 'RUN-' || TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('minute', created_at), 'YYYYMMDD-HH24MI') || '-' || data_source_type AS "id", data_source_type AS "source", MAX(reporting_year || '-' || LPAD(period_value::text, 2, '0')) AS "basePeriod", 'AUTO' AS "triggerType", TO_CHAR(MIN(created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "startedAt", TO_CHAR(MAX(created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "completedAt", COUNT(id) AS "success", 0 AS "error", 'SUCCESS' AS "status" FROM esg_metric_data WHERE data_source_type != 'MANUAL' GROUP BY data_source_type, DATE_TRUNC('minute', created_at) ORDER BY MAX(created_at) DESC LIMIT 50
